title: Certifying Emphysema Densitometry from Thick-Slice CT by Residual Arbitration
method_name: ARC-CT (Arbitrated Reconstruction with Certificates for CT)
abstract_draft: Emphysema is quantified from chest CT by a threshold statistic of the lung attenuation histogram — the percentage of voxels below -950 HU (LAA-950) and the 15th percentile of lung attenuation — but most archived chest CT is reconstructed at 5-8 mm slice thickness, where slab averaging biases both. Deep restoration of thick-slice CT is now clinically validated on diagnostic endpoints (openalex:W4404646478) and benchmarked on real 1 mm/5 mm pairs (dblp:journals/corr/abs-2206-06253), yet both are optimised and judged as images. Because the map from a reconstruction to a threshold statistic is many-to-one, a restoration that DISPLACES the histogram and one that RECOVERS its low-attenuation tail are indistinguishable to every objective and metric currently used: in our preliminary run on real 5 mm data, the entire LAA-950 gain from real-pair fine-tuning was reproduced by changing a single output-bias scalar by -12.2 HU, while the reconstructed histogram stayed too narrow. ARC-CT decomposes the pipeline into three solvers that exchange a typed, machine-checkable artifact instead of activations: a non-learned solver identifies the through-plane acquisition per scan (effective slice width, noise, unexplained-residual fraction), the network reconstructs conditioned on that identification, and a moment-based solver decomposes the data-consistency residual into a displacement term and a structural term — the displacement term being invariant to the width estimate because slab averaging preserves slab means. The arbiter certifies, flags or abstains per scan, with no thin-slice reference. Falsification: on held-out real pairs, the displacement term must separate a genuinely improved model from a displacement-improved one, and freezing the operator identification at the nominal width must return LAA-950 concordance to the un-adapted regime. Expected outcome: densitometric values from restored thick-slice CT that carry evidence, rather than accuracy of unknown provenance.
core_claim: Because slab averaging preserves slab means for every slice-profile width, the mean direction of a reconstruction's data-consistency residual identifies a global attenuation displacement independently of the acquisition estimate — so a thick-slice restoration can state, per scan and without a thin-slice reference, whether its emphysema index is carried by a displacement of the attenuation histogram or by evidence the measurement actually supports.

sub_claims.statement: On real 5 mm chest CT, the LAA-950 improvement obtained by fine-tuning a densitometry-guarded restoration model on real pairs is reproduced by changing one scalar — the network's output bias — leaving the reconstructed lung histogram's width unchanged.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: the empirical reveal in the hook; motivates why a threshold statistic needs a provenance statement

sub_claims.statement: The displacement term of the residual, computed over the eroded interior of the lung set, is invariant to the operator width estimate (measured spread 0.04 HU across 4-10 mm on a real pair) while the un-eroded version varies by 9.4 HU over the same range.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: the identifiability pivot: what makes the certificate meaningful under an unknown acquisition

sub_claims.statement: The effective through-plane width of a real 5 mm series is identifiable per scan from the series itself (median 6.25 mm over 50 real pairs, versus the 5.00 mm nominal value), and conditioning the reconstruction on it is separable from using it to audit the reconstruction.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: the audit leg — the fixed-operator assumption is false and its relaxation is testable

sub_claims.statement: A per-scan certify/flag/abstain verdict computable without any thin-slice reference separates a genuinely improved model from a displacement-improved one on held-out real pairs.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: the deployment claim: the verdict leg, and the falsification's outcome metric

key_equations.description: The through-plane acquisition model: a normalised Gaussian slice-sensitivity profile of full-width-half-maximum w applied along z, followed by an average over r thin slices per thick slice.
key_equations.description_zh: 层厚采集模型：沿 z 方向做归一化高斯层敏感度卷积（半高全宽 w），再对每 r 层薄层取平均得到一层厚层。

key_equations.description: The operator solver: a grid fit of the effective width from the observed thick series itself, plus the fraction of the observation the fitted physics cannot explain.
key_equations.description_zh: 算子求解器：直接从观测到的厚层序列网格拟合有效层厚，并给出该物理模型无法解释的观测占比。

key_equations.description: The displacement term and the invariance it rests on: over the eroded interior L_e of the lung set, the slab average preserves the mean for every width, so a global attenuation offset is identified independently of the width estimate.
key_equations.description_zh: 位移项及其依据的不变性：在肺区集合的腐蚀内部 L_e 上，厚层平均对任意层厚都保持均值，因此全局 HU 偏移的识别与层厚估计无关。

key_equations.description: The arbiter: a feasibility verdict on the certificate rather than a score, naming the dominant violated term when it flags.
key_equations.description_zh: 仲裁器：对证书做可行性判定而非打分，判为 flagged 时给出主导违反项。

key_equations.description: The single new training term: the displacement penalty, which bills the free lunch the trajectory guardrail otherwise takes.
key_equations.description_zh: 训练侧唯一新增项：位移惩罚，用来对轨迹护栏原本可以白拿的那部分收益计价。

method_flow.high_level_pipeline: A thick-slice chest CT series arrives with no phantom, no reference protocol and no thin-slice counterpart. A non-learned operator solver first asks what acquisition could have produced it, fitting an effective through-plane width and noise level from the series itself and reporting how much of the observation that fitted physics cannot explain. The reconstruction network is then conditioned on that identification rather than on a nominal slice width, and returns a 1 mm volume. A moment-based densitometry solver takes the reconstruction back through the identified acquisition and splits the disagreement with the observation into a global displacement term — the one direction slab averaging leaves invariant, so it is readable no matter what width was fitted — and a structural remainder, adding a protocol-calibrated tail-recovery term when a calibration for this protocol exists. The arbiter reads the resulting certificate and returns certify, flag or abstain together with the emphysema index, so the number leaves the pipeline with its provenance attached.

steps.title: Build real thin/thick pairs and a matched simulated arm
steps.what_changes: Turns raw paired NIfTI volumes into z-aligned, integer-ratio .npy pairs plus a per-case audit row, and creates a simulated arm from the same anatomy with a KNOWN operator.
steps.why_this_step: The confound-isolating separation the audit leg owes needs two arms that differ only in whether the acquisition is known.
steps.linked_falsification: supplies the held-out real pairs the falsification experiment runs on

steps.title: Identify the acquisition per scan (operator solver)
steps.what_changes: Fits the effective through-plane width by grid search over 2.00-12.00 mm and estimates the through-plane noise, reporting the unexplained-residual fraction and whether the fit sits at a grid endpoint.
steps.why_this_step: Every certificate term is computed under this estimate; a nominal width both hides a displacement inside the residual and mis-conditions the network.
steps.linked_falsification: the negative control freezes this step at the nominal 5.00 mm
steps.input: thick volume y, current thin estimate x_tilde
steps.output: (w_hat, sigma_hat, rho) + the full fit profile

steps.title: Condition the reconstruction on the identified acquisition
steps.what_changes: Replaces the constant nominal-width conditioning of the network's identification module with (w_hat, sigma_hat), which changes the reconstructed volume and therefore every statistic read off it.
steps.why_this_step: Separates identification-for-conditioning from identification-for-auditing, which ablation (c) then measures.
steps.linked_falsification: ablation (c) removes this conditioning while keeping the certificate

steps.title: Fit the tail-recovery calibration on training pairs only
steps.what_changes: Regresses the thin-slice through-plane lung variance on quantities observable at inference and measures the held-out residual spread, refusing to ship the term when the relation carries no information.
steps.why_this_step: The closed-form attenuation identity is false by an order of magnitude on real data, so the tail-recovery evidence must be empirical and scoped.
steps.linked_falsification: the tail-recovery term is one of the quantities the falsification compares across arms
steps.output: fitted relation f, its residual spread sigma_v, the protocol tag

steps.title: Compute the certificate (densitometry solver)
steps.what_changes: Builds the eroded interior of the lung set, computes the displacement term, the structural remainder and — when calibrated — the tail-recovery term, emitting ABSTAIN on an empty set and UNAVAILABLE without a calibration.
steps.why_this_step: This is the typed artifact that crosses the boundary between the learned and the physical parts of the pipeline.
steps.linked_falsification: the displacement term is the load-bearing variable of the falsification

steps.title: Validate the estimators on a known-perfect reconstruction
steps.what_changes: Runs the certificate with the TRUE thin volume in place of the reconstruction on held-out pairs; any term that does not return its null value is reported as estimator bias before any model claim is made.
steps.why_this_step: This check is what exposed the two defects in the first version of the mechanism, and it is cheap enough to be mandatory.
steps.linked_falsification: establishes the null values against which the falsification's arms are read
steps.output: per-term bias floor (e.g. the -0.55 HU displacement floor measured on a real pair)

steps.title: Add the displacement penalty and re-train
steps.what_changes: Adds lambda_delta |delta_hat| to the existing composite loss; the gradient flows through the identified acquisition into the network and shifts the reconstruction's lung mean, changing the LAA-950 count it produces.
steps.why_this_step: It bills the one direction the trajectory guardrail could otherwise use to buy densitometric accuracy for free.

steps.title: Arbitrate and gate the reported value
steps.what_changes: Implements certify / flag / abstain as a pure function of the certificate and the three thresholds, emitting the verdict, the dominant violated term and the gated densitometric value.
steps.why_this_step: Converts a disagreement between assumed physics and observation into a statement about the number a clinician reads.
steps.linked_falsification: the verdict is the per-scan output whose separation power the experiment tests

steps.title: Evaluate five arms under one harness
steps.what_changes: Computes endpoint metrics and the certificate jointly for the trilinear baseline, the restoration model, its real-pair fine-tuned version, its output-bias-only recalibration and ARC-CT; no arm may report an endpoint without its certificate.
steps.why_this_step: The bias-only arm is the positive control that makes the hook's claim checkable.
steps.linked_falsification: this harness IS the falsification experiment
steps.input: all trained arms, held-out real pairs

steps.title: Ablate the decomposition
steps.what_changes: Freezes the operator solver at the nominal width, zeroes the displacement penalty, removes the conditioning while keeping the certificate, and sweeps the erosion radius over 4-12 voxels.
steps.why_this_step: Isolates the marginal contribution of each solver, which is what separates a decomposition from an assembly.
steps.linked_falsification: the frozen-operator run is the falsification's negative control

steps.title: Repeat at 8 mm without retuning
steps.what_changes: Runs the whole pipeline at r = 8 on simulated 8 mm slabs and checks that the operator solver returns a wider width and the thresholds still apply.
steps.why_this_step: Cross-thickness transfer is the practical reason the operator is identified rather than assumed.
steps.linked_falsification: an out-of-training-regime check on the same load-bearing variable

steps.title: Report certificate distributions per arm
steps.what_changes: Contrasts the certificate distribution on the simulated arm (operator known) against the real arm (operator identified), which is the confound-isolating separation the audit leg promised.
steps.why_this_step: Shows whether the residual the identified operator cannot explain is what separates simulated from real performance.
steps.linked_falsification: supports the mechanism claim beyond the single load-bearing variable

method_flow.design_reasoning_echo: The design starts from a measured failure rather than from an architecture: on real thick-slice data the apparent densitometric gain of real-pair fine-tuning was carried by a single output-bias scalar, which means the objective could buy the endpoint without buying the evidence. The naive fix — add a data-consistency loss under the nominal operator and report its residual — fails because the nominal operator is wrong (5.00 mm assumed against 6.25 mm fitted, with 12.8% of the thick signal unexplained), so the residual conflates operator error with reconstruction error and the displacement hides inside it. The mechanism therefore identifies the operator per scan and then decomposes the residual along the direction that moves a threshold count. Two design decisions are deliberate: the tail-recovery term is report-only and never trained on, because a model can satisfy a variance target by injecting through-plane noise; and the reconstruction is NOT projected onto exact data consistency, because doing so would hard-code the fitted operator into the output and make the certificate vacuous by construction. The mechanism also stays off three occupied positions in the field's lineage: deconvolving with a phantom-measured profile, harmonising to a reference kernel or protocol, and letting a reasoning agent select restoration tools.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Prepare matched scan pairs: line up each hospital thick-slice series with its own thin-slice reconstruction, and separately make a simulated thick series from the thin one where you KNOW exactly how it was made.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: You need two situations that differ only in whether the averaging process is known, otherwise you can never tell whether a failure came from the physics or from the network.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Ask the scan how it was made: search over candidate averaging widths (2 to 12 mm) for the one that best explains the thick series, and record how much of the scan that best explanation still cannot account for.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: Everything downstream is judged against this estimate; if you assume the nominal width instead, the assumption error and the network error get mixed together.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Tell the network what you found: feed the estimated width and noise level into the network instead of a fixed nominal value.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The network should reconstruct the volume implied by the acquisition this scan actually had, not by the one written on the box.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Calibrate the 'did it restore texture' yardstick on training scans only, and measure how noisy that yardstick is on scans it never saw.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The textbook formula for how much texture averaging removes is off by an order of magnitude on real data, so this yardstick has to be measured rather than derived, and it must carry the honest error bar that comes with that.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Compute the certificate: put the reconstruction back through the estimated averaging, compare it with the actual thick scan, and split the disagreement into (a) a plain overall shift, (b) everything else, and (c) the texture yardstick.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The overall shift is the part that fakes a good emphysema number, and it is the one part that can be read off no matter which averaging width was estimated.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Sanity-check the certificate on a scan whose answer you know: feed in the TRUE thin volume instead of a reconstruction and confirm each term returns its expected null value.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: If the yardstick condemns a perfect answer, it is measuring your estimator's bias rather than the model's behaviour - this check caught exactly that twice while designing the method.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Train with the shift penalised: add the size of that overall shift to the training objective.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: It removes the cheapest way for training to make the emphysema number look right without earning it.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Decide and gate: turn the certificate into one of three verdicts - certified, flagged (naming which part failed), or abstain - and attach it to the emphysema number.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: A trial needs to know whether this scan's value may be pooled with the others, and that decision should come from the data, not from paperwork.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Compare five versions under one identical harness, each reporting both its emphysema numbers and its certificate.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: One of the five is the un-tuned model with only its output bias corrected - if that alone matches the fine-tuned model, the whole argument of the paper is confirmed.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Remove one piece at a time: freeze the width estimate at the nominal value, switch off the shift penalty, remove the conditioning, and sweep how much the mask is shrunk.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: This is what shows the decomposition is doing the work, rather than extra data or a longer training schedule.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Repeat everything for 8 mm slices without retuning anything.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: If the width really is estimated rather than assumed, a thicker series should just report a wider width and keep working.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Report the certificate's distribution separately for simulated and real scans.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: This shows directly how much of the simulated-to-real performance drop is explained by the part of the scan the estimated physics cannot account for.

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 准备配对数据：把每一例医院里的厚层序列和它自己的薄层重建对齐；另外再用薄层人工合成一份厚层，这份的生成方式是完全已知的。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 你需要两种只在「生成过程是否已知」上有差别的情形，否则永远分不清失败是物理建模错了还是网络错了。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 问扫描本身它是怎么来的：在 2 到 12 mm 的候选平均窗口里搜出最能解释该厚层序列的那个，并记录这个最优解释仍然解释不了的比例。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 后面所有判断都以这个估计为准；如果直接用标称层厚，假设误差和网络误差就被混在一起了。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 把结果告诉网络：用估计出来的层厚和噪声水平做条件输入，替换掉原来固定的标称值。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 网络应该重建「这次扫描真实采集方式」所蕴含的体数据，而不是设备标签上写的那一个。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 只在训练集上标定「是否真的把纹理找回来了」这把尺子，并在没见过的病例上测出这把尺子本身有多大误差。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 教科书公式算出的纹理衰减量在真实数据上差了一个数量级，所以这把尺子必须实测而不是推导，并且要带上它应有的误差棒。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 计算证书：把重建结果按估计出的平均方式再过一遍，与真实厚层比较，把不一致拆成 (a) 整体平移、(b) 其余结构残差、(c) 纹理尺子三部分。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 整体平移正是那个能把肺气肿指标「做对」的假动作，而且无论层厚估计成多少，它都能被读出来。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 拿已知答案的病例检验证书：把真实薄层直接当成「重建结果」送进去，确认每一项都回到它应有的零值。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 如果这把尺子连完美答案都判不合格，那它量的是估计器自身的偏差而不是模型的行为——设计过程中这一步就抓出了两个这样的错误。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 带着平移惩罚训练：把整体平移的绝对值加进训练目标。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这堵死了训练过程中「不劳而获」把指标做好看的最便宜那条路。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 判定并把关：把证书变成三种结论之一——通过、标记（并指出是哪一项没过）、或弃权，并把结论附在肺气肿指标上。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 临床试验需要知道这一例的数值能不能和其它例合并统计，而这个判断应该来自数据本身，而不是来自 protocol 文书。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 在同一套评测流程下比较五个版本，每个版本都必须同时给出指标和证书。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 其中一个版本是「只把输出偏置校正了」的原模型——如果它就能追平完整微调，本文的核心论断就被证实了。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 逐个拆掉组件：把层厚估计冻结在标称值、关掉平移惩罚、去掉条件输入、扫描掩膜腐蚀半径。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这才能说明起作用的是这套分解，而不是更多数据或更长的训练。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 在 8 mm 层厚上原样重跑一遍，不调任何超参。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 如果层厚真的是估出来的而不是假设的，那么更厚的序列应该只是报出一个更大的层厚，然后照常工作。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 分别报告合成臂与真实臂上的证书分布。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这能直接看出：合成到真实的性能落差，有多少是由「估计出的物理解释不了的那部分」造成的。
